result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: in the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant meta line for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows overlapping text ('25–30 min' and '€0 delivery' rendered on top of each other), making both unreadable. Other elements (header, chips, promo banner, carousel clipping, bottom-cut card) behave as expected features.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' list, the meta row under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' has two text strings ('25–30 min' and '€0 delivery') overlapping each other, producing garbled, unreadable text ('25–3€0 delivery' style overlap).
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout of the meta row so the delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine tag are laid out sequentially (e.g., flex row with gap or proper separators) instead of being absolutely positioned/stacked on top of one another.

issues.description: The delivery fee information for Tokumaru Ramen Bar is duplicated/conflicting: the card badge says '€0 delivery' while the overlapped meta line also appears to include a delivery fee string, adding to the confusion.
issues.suggestion: Ensure only one delivery-fee indicator is shown per card, or clearly differentiate badge (promo) from meta line content after fixing the overlap.
